time_constraint: single remaining Level 3 shot; no alternative budgets or post-hoc schedule tuning
freshness: bodies 6 and 7 were not used for low_max_abs discovery or selection; both have finite verified checkpoints
held_out_freshness: newly generated held-out sequences distinct from the prior default set; identical for every arm
step_count_basis: measured 200-step low_max_abs cost at 75% is approximately 40.04T across prior bodies; 116 steps is the closest integer match to 23.207T and must be within 0.2% after measured accounting
primary_endpoint: final sparse held-out loss of low_max_abs versus dense-fewer at measured near-identical total cost and at exact interpolated dense-fewer cost
secondary_endpoints: sparse accuracy and full evaluation trajectory
realized activity, auxiliary operations, measured FLOPs, and wall clock

decision_rules.first_shot_win: low_max_abs final sparse loss is below dense-fewer, remains below after exact-cost interpolation, and is below random
decision_rules.replication: only a first_shot_win launches the identical body-7 comparison
decision_rules.preliminary_level_3: the same win must replicate on body 7 without any changes
decision_rules.failure: if body 6 loses, do not run body 7, try another activity budget, or claim Level 3

prohibited: early stopping based on intermediate losses
changing activity, step counts, seeds, or evaluation data after launch
using dense-body quality as the primary endpoint
claiming broad hard Level 3 across sizes or budgets from this single operating point
